title: Easy Anti-Cheat launch error: "Easy Anti-Cheat is not installed" or the service failed to start
summary: A game with Easy Anti-Cheat won't start. Repairing Easy Anti-Cheat from the game's folder fixes most cases.
cause: Easy Anti-Cheat runs as a Windows service. If its files are damaged or its service is disabled or blocked, the game refuses to launch.
steps: Open the game's install folder, then the EasyAntiCheat folder. Right-click EasyAntiCheat_Setup.exe (or EasyAntiCheat_EOS_Setup.exe) and choose Run as administrator.
Pick the game from the list and click Repair Service. Click Finish and restart your PC.
If it still fails, run the same file again, click Uninstall, then run it once more and click Install Easy Anti-Cheat.
Press Win+R, type services.msc, find Easy Anti-Cheat and make sure it is not set to Disabled.
Add the game's folder to your antivirus exclusions, then verify the game files in Steam or the Epic Games Launcher.
ifStillBroken: Run the game's launcher as administrator. If it still fails, send the exact error text to OldWolfDev for a personal review.
